get.description: Lists agents.
Returns an agent by ID.

post.description: Runs an agent in playground mode, streaming the execution via SSE.

get.description: Lists API keys, with optional pagination.

post.description: Creates a new API key. The plaintext key is only returned once, on creation.

get.description: Returns the API key used to authenticate the current request.
Returns an API key by ID.

delete.description: Deletes an API key by ID.

put.description: Marks an API key as active.
Marks an API key as disabled.
Updates the expiration date of an API key.

post.description: Rotates an API key, invalidating the previous secret. The new plaintext key is only returned once.

get.description: Returns public application configuration.
Returns application system information.

post.description: Creates or authenticates an anonymous client user.
Authenticates a client user through the given auth provider (e.g. google, github).
Exchanges a refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair.

get.description: Lists sessions of a client, with optional pagination and includes.

post.description: Creates a new session for a client.

get.description: Returns a session by ID.
Lists the execution messages of a session, with optional ordering/pagination.

post.description: Runs an agent within a session, streaming the execution via SSE.

get.description: Lists users of a client, with optional ordering/pagination.

post.description: Creates an anonymous user for a client.
Creates a client user via API key (server-to-server).

get.description: Returns the authenticated user for the given client.
Lists clients, with optional pagination.
Returns a client by code.
Lists agents linked to a client, with optional pagination.
Returns public information for a client by code.
Lists knowledge bases, with optional pagination.
Lists the available knowledge source drivers.
Lists the available knowledge index drivers.

post.description: Tests a knowledge source driver configuration without persisting it.

get.description: Returns a knowledge base by ID.

put.description: Updates a knowledge base by ID.

delete.description: Deletes a knowledge base by ID.

get.description: Lists items of a knowledge base, with optional pagination.

post.description: Triggers a sync of a knowledge base's items from its source.

get.description: Lists indexes of a knowledge base, with optional pagination.

post.description: Creates a new index for a knowledge base.

get.description: Returns a knowledge index by ID.

put.description: Updates a knowledge index by ID.

delete.description: Deletes a knowledge index by ID.

get.description: Lists items of a knowledge index, with optional pagination.
Lists configured LLMs, with optional pagination.
Lists the available LLM provider drivers.
Returns an LLM by ID.
